description: Great starter home in Riverside featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms with 1,071 sq ft of living space, ideally located on a quiet cul-de-sac. Situated on a 6,534 sq ft lot, this property offers RV parking, a 2-car garage, and a permitted sunroom with its own wall AC unit, ideal for entertaining space. Enjoy newer kitchen counters, updated flooring throughout, and fresh front yard hardscape with lighting for great curb appeal.
